items.source: Variant of RSocketRequester.RequestSpec.data(Object) that also accepts a hint for the types of values that will be produced.

items.translation: `RSocketRequester.RequestSpec.data(Object, Class)` 的变体，用于类型提示需要泛型类型的情况。
